license: All rights reserved; no reuse license granted by this release
purpose: Public reference implementation for evidence-native verification, validation, and mission assurance.
public_boundary: Software, schemas, synthetic fixtures, and public-safe documentation only; no real external program identities or nonpublic evidence.
does: validate assurance-graph structure and selected semantics
list unresolved assumptions without automated priority scoring
expose direct evidence gaps on critical nodes
show dependency impact through declared depends_on/requires relations
verify declared artifact hashes and numerical acceptance checks
explicitly reproduce trusted receipt commands when the user invokes fma reproduce
verify that decision-receipt basis references exist in a valid graph
does_not: expose a private operational assurance kernel
calculate proprietary or autonomous engineering priority
validate nonpublic external systems or practices
authorize safety, security, acquisition, compliance, or mission readiness
serve as a public storage location for real program evidence
distribution: GitHub source/release workflow; public package-index upload intentionally blocked by package metadata.
evidence_lifecycle: Source-controlled validation records deterministic candidate evidence; commit-specific hosted proof belongs to GitHub Actions and tagged release metadata to avoid stale or recursive receipts.
maintenance: Keep main as the only long-lived branch; keep issue forms self-describing without custom-label dependencies; evaluate dependency-major upgrades separately from a frozen release candidate; rerun full V&V after material source changes.
